title: Senior Sales Manager - Media (m/w/d)
description:
Who We Are

Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers-no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at verve.com .

Der fehlende Wirkungsnachweis ist das größte Problem im stationären Handel für Werbungtreibende. Obwohl Marken Millionen in Werbung am Point of Sale investieren, können sie nicht belegen, ob daraus
Käufe wurden. Verve Retail Media (VRM) löst dieses Problem. Wir vermarkten und betreiben digitale Werbe-Screens in mehreren tausend LEH-, Drogerie- und Convenience-Standorten und verbinden sie mit digitalen
Coupons, Retargeting im CTV und anderen Offsite-Kanälen. Marken buchen bei uns keine isolierten Werbeformate, sondern 360-Grad-Kampagnen, die zu Hause starten und bis zum Einkaufsregal reichen -eine Closed-Loop-Messung auf Basis realer Kassendaten.

VRM ist die eigenständige Retail Media Unit der börsennotierten Verve Group SE. Wir arbeiten wie ein schnell skalierendes Startup mit AI-First-Strategie über alle Funktionen und mit Zugriff auf die Infrastruktur eines internationalen AdTech-Unternehmens mit über einer Billionen ausgelieferter Werbeimpressionen pro Jahr. Zur Verve Retail Media gehört seit kurzem der Couponing- und Cashback-Spezialist acardo.

Die Rolle in einem Satz
Du trägst eine Hunter-Mentalität in dir und gewinnst neue Umsätze bei FMCG-Marken, indem du integrierte Shopper Activation Kampagnen verkaufst: d.h. coupon-getriebene Conversion und messbarer Sales Lift, idealerweise erweitert um Screen-Präsenz im Markt.

Was du verkaufst

• Ein kombiniertes Produkt aus digitaler Sichtbarkeit im Markt Screens an Eingang, Fläche, Kasse), Aktivierung am Point of Sale (über Coupons) und Closed-Loop-Messung auf Basis realer Kassendaten (anstatt isolierter Werbeflächen oder losgelöster Coupons)

• Kampagnen, die drei Logiken beim Kunden verbinden: Markenreichweite, Abverkauf und Kategorie-Relevanz

• 360Grad-Aktivierung, die über den Markt hinausgeht: (Re)Targeting im CTV und weiteren Offsite-Kanälen als Verlängerung der In-Store-Kampagne

• Konkrete Beweispunkte aus Pilotprojekten: z.B. 9% Uplift auf Store-Ebene, 20% in ausgewählten Kategorien

An wen du verkaufst

• Direkt an FMCG-Marken

• Die Ansprechpartner kommen meist aus Brand und Media (-Planung und -Einkauf) und verwalten drei Budgettöpfe mit unterschiedlichen Zielen, Freigabelogiken und Erfolgsmetriken

Deine Aufgaben

• Eigene Pipeline aufbauen, entwickeln, priorisieren und mit belastbarem Forecast führen

• Neukunden und Stakeholder (horizontal und vertikal) gewinnen und Kunden zu wiederkehrenden Partnern entwickeln

• Den kompletten Sales-Zyklus verantworten: Erstansprache, Qualifizierung, Bedarfsanalyse, Angebot, Verhandlung und Abschluss. Mit Abschluss erfolgt die Übergabe ans AdOps Team

• Kundenziele in Media- und Aktivierungskonzepte übersetzen: Touchpoints, Reichweiten, Zielgruppen, Mechaniken Cashback, Gratis-Testen, Kategorie-Trigger), Messansatz

• Sales-Lift-Daten und Pilotergebnisse als Beweispunkte im Pitch einsetzen, um aus ersten Testbudgets hohe wiederkehrende Volumina zu machen

• VRM gegenüber konkurrierenden Retail-Media-Formaten klar differenzieren

• Feedback aus dem Markt in Produkt, Pitchmaterial und Go-to-Market zurückspielen

So ist die Rolle aufgesetzt

• Du bist ein Individual Contributor ohne Personalverantwortung

• Du berichtest direkt an die CSO

• Du verkaufst eigenständig, aber nicht allein: Media Planning entwickelt das Kampagnen-Setup, Ad Operations steuert die Ausli

title: Technical Writer

Your work is the last line of clarity between a complex, cutting-edge system and the person who has to operate it under pressure. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and the Pre & Post Sales team - translating deeply technical content into structured, accessible, operationally relevant documentation. This is a high-craft, high-ownership role in a company where the quality of your writing directly affects operational outcomes. title: Senior re:Members/Impexium Analyst
description:
About SAS
SAS is an accounting, technology, design, and human resources outsourcing firm dedicated to serving membership-based nonprofits, including trade associations and professional societies. We understand the unique challenges these organizations face and provide tailored solutions to streamline their operations. By partnering with SAS, organizations can focus on their mission while we handle the complexities of system selection, implementation, security, budgeting, reporting, compliance, and day-to-day tasks. Our goal is to enhance operational efficiency and financial stability, building a foundation for long-term success for our clients.
Position Summary

• As a Senior re:Members/Impexium Analyst within the SAS Technology team, you will play a vital role in providing advanced business analysis, consultation, and project management services to our clients. Following established best practices, you will focus on evaluating, implementing, and supporting a variety of technologies, including Association Management Systems (AMS), Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Systems, Website Content Management Systems (CMS), and other tools utilized by trade associations and professional societies. Experience working directly with re:Members and/or Impexium is highly desired. Candidates with implementation experience in other Association Management Systems (AMS), such as iMIS, NetForum, Nimble, or YourMembership, will also be considered. This mid-level role involves a deep understanding of business processes, technical requirements, and a commitment to driving efficiency through technology solutions.
SAS is a fully remote company - this position will be 100% remote.
Essential Functions
Collect and Document Technical and Functional Requirements

• Gather, document, and validate technical and functional business requirements fromourclients.

• Work closely with clients to understand their unique needs and translate them into actionable system requirements.
Evaluate and Configure Business Systems

• Assess the functions and features of various business systems supported byour clients.

• Compare system capabilities with client needs, identifying and addressing functionality gaps.

• Implement and configure business systems according to documented requirements.
Testing and Quality Assurance

• Conduct thorough testing of business systems against documented requirements.

• Identify and document any deviations or deficiencies, ensuring the systems meet quality standards.
Project Management

• Follow project plans, reporting progress regularly to stakeholders.

• Proactively identify potential concerns or delays and communicate them to management.
Prioritization and Process Improvement

• Collaborate with management to prioritize business and information needs.

• Identify and define opportunities for business process improvement.
Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree preferred.

• 4+years of experience as a Systems Analyst working in re:Members/Impexium and with a focus on business analysis and technology implementation.

• 3+years of experience with Association Management Systems (AMS) or Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Systems. Candidates with provenexpertiseon there:Members(formerlyImpexium) AMS will be favored.

• Proficiency in Website Content Management Systems (CMS) such as WordPress or Drupal.

• Strong written communication and documentation skills.

• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to collect, organize, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with associations, nonprofits, or mission-driven organizations.

• Familiarity with data querying languages (SQL, JSONiq) and data management/analysis tools.

• Knowledge of project management principles or experience leading a technology project.

title: Engineering Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering
description:
At Warner Music Group , we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:
• Curiosity : We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.
• Collaboration : Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.
• Commitment : We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.
Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s signing up new artists; ensuring we provide the right data to Spotify, YouTube, and other digital service providers; or helping artists use the latest AI tools and make thoughtful decisions with data-driven insights - technology plays an invaluable role in our success. The engineering team at Warner Music Group makes all of it a reality. Check out first-hand accounts from the WMG engineering, product, design, infrastructure and data teams in our blog!
WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.
Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds - an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
A little bit about our team:
WMG Technology’s Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team sits at the intersection of enterprise engineering and business enablement. We embed engineers with global business units - including Finance, HR, and our recorded music labels - to turn operational pain points into high-value AI and automation solutions.
Working directly with the business, we run a centralized intake, routing, and delivery model so the business can move in days or weeks using existing tools, while larger foundational work graduates cleanly onto the product roadmap. We set a shared technical bar, reuse what already works, and keep AI deployments secure, cost-transparent, and maintainable.
Your role:

Reporting to the Director of FDE & AI Optimization, the Engineering Manager will lead a team of embedded engineers and own how FDE work is taken in, built, reused, and graduated.

This is a hands-on people-manager role. You will coach engineers who sit inside lines of business while holding a centralized technical reporting structure, operating playbook, and delivery standard. You will partner with Data Engineer, Product Owner, and business sponsors to turn ambiguous requests into a clear, repeatable operating model - and to make sure FDE is a trusted path for AI optimization, not a shadow-IT queue.

The ideal manager brings an equal blend of technical judgment and organizational empathy: comfortable in the tools, rigorous about routing and reuse, and able to help non-technical stakeholders translate operational pain points into work the team can actually ship.

Here you’ll get to:

• Build, coach, and manage a high-performing FDE team, including hiring, performance, and embedding engineers in specific lines of business while keeping them aligned to core tech standards.

• Define, scale, and maintain the FDE technical operating playbook - intake standards, routing rules, reusable delivery models, and engagem

title: Chief Operating Officer
description:
About World Business Lenders

•
World Business Lenders (WBL) is a privately held portfolio lender specializing in real estate-secured business loans for underserved businesses. WBL operates with a fully remote, multinational workforce and an experienced executive leadership team.

• Typically, the work schedule is from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday , though additional hours may be required based on business needs.

About the Role

• The Chief Operating Officer is responsible for providing operational leadership and coordination across the Company’s Lending Operations, including Intake, Processing, Valuation, Underwriting, Title, and Closing, as well as Asset Resolution and Loan Administration (Servicing).

• This role will work closely with the senior leadership responsible for each function to ensure these areas operate as an integrated, end-to-end lending and asset lifecycle.

• The Chief Operating Officer will focus on improving coordination within and between departments, establishing consistent processes and performance standards, identifying operational bottlenecks, monitoring key performance indicators, and ensuring that issues are addressed before they negatively impact lending, servicing, or asset resolution.

• The Chief Operating Officer will focus on process integration, performance standards, operational efficiency, cross-functional coordination, and resolution of issues across the broader lending and asset lifecycle.

• The position will report directly to the Chief Executive Officer and will serve as a key operational partner to executive leadership. The role will provide visibility into operational performance, risks, capacity, and opportunities for improvement across the functions within its scope.

What Success Looks Like

• Improve coordination and accountability across Lending Operations, Asset Resolution, and Loan Administration.

• Reduce operational bottlenecks and unnecessary handoffs.

• Improve turnaround times and overall process efficiency.

• Establish clear and measurable operational KPIs and improve visibility into performance for executive leadership.

• Identify and resolve recurring operational issues.

• Build scalable processes capable of supporting the company's continued growth.

• Create a unified and efficient end-to-end operating model across the lending, servicing, and asset-resolution lifecycle.

What You'll Be Doing (Core Responsibilities)

• Operational Leadership

• Provide overall operational oversight across Lending Operations (Intake, Processing, Valuation, Underwriting, Title, and Closing), Asset Resolution, and Loan Administration (Servicing).

• Work directly with the functional leaders of each area to establish priorities, processes, performance expectations, and operational objectives.

• Ensure the functions within Lending Operations, Asset Resolution, and Loan Administration operate as an integrated process, with clear ownership and accountability for cross-departmental workflows.

• Identify operational gaps, inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and communication breakdowns across the closing and asset lifecycle.

• Develop and maintain standardized operating procedures, workflows, controls, service-level expectations, and escalation processes.

• Monitor operational performance and provide regular updates and recommendations to the CEO.

• Closing Operations Oversight

• Work with Closing Operations leadership to monitor closing, funding, and related operational activities.

• Identify recurring issues affecting Closing Operations or movement through the closing pipeline.

• Coordinate with Valuations, Asset Resolution, Underwriting, Sales, Legal, Finance, and other relevant functions to improve execution.

• Review operational reporting and identify trends requiring management attention.

• Valuations Oversight

• Work with Valuations leadership to ensure valuation activities are properly integrated into closing and asset-resolution processes.

• Expertise in HubL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and working with REST/SOAP APIs

• Proven experience building advanced workflows, lead scoring models, and segmentation strategies

• Strong communication and collaboration abilities and expound technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

title: Senior Manager, Accounts Payable - Compute
description:

OpenAI’s compute infrastructure depends on controlled execution of significant supplier spend. As Senior Manager, Accounts Payable - Compute, you will own payment readiness and material exceptions across large-value, business-critical obligations. Complex agreements evolve through amendments to pricing, capacity, service credits, billing mechanics, legal entities, and payment schedules. You will translate approved obligations into accurate, timely payments while navigating supplier disputes, late approvals, close deadlines, and cross-system dependencies.

We’re looking for a hands-on technical and operational leader who can interpret complex payment terms, reconcile financial data, diagnose system failures, and build scalable workflows. Coordinating across multiple Compute Finance and Accounting teams is a core responsibility: you will establish decision owners, align deadlines, and move interdependent work forward in parallel. You will set the compute AP operating plan and lead delivery with Procurement, Treasury, Tax, Finance Systems, and existing processing teams, with measurable improvements in controls, service, and capacity.

In this role, you will:

- Own the compute invoice-to-payment operating plan, prioritize material exceptions, and lead supplier escalations across complex, high-value obligations and tight payment deadlines.

- Interpret executed contracts and approved amendments affecting pricing, capacity, credits, billing mechanics, entities, and payment schedules; translate them into invoice-validation, PO/change-order, approval, control, and payment requirements.

- Personally investigate discrepancies, supplier disputes, missing credits, duplicate risks, and PO coverage gaps. Track decision owners, deadlines, blockers, and escalation paths so material payments move forward as approval lands.

- Confirm supplier, site, entity, tax, payment-method, and approval readiness with the relevant owners before payment release.

- Coordinate funding forecasts and close-period payments with Treasury; reconcile invoice aging, payment registers, and bank/settlement evidence to support Accounting’s completeness and cutoff conclusions.

- Design matching tolerances, validation rules, exception routing, evidence requirements, and escalation thresholds with control and accounting partners, preserving independent verification and segregation of duties.

- Map compute workload and usable capacity by task and complexity, assign eligible work across employees, contractors, and shared-service teams, and maintain trained backups and close coverage. Coach task owners and backups, strengthen execution standards, and build greater team autonomy.

- Set a prioritized improvement roadmap tied to compute business needs. Own requirements and acceptance criteria for workflow and AI improvements; lead operational testing and adoption with Finance Systems and Enablement, verify reconciliation and fallback, and measure service, risk, and verified capacity outcomes.

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

title: Senior SoC Architect (f/m/d)
description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

We are seeking a skilled Senior SoC Architect at Black Semiconductor to drive the architecture of our entire Electronics-Photonics IC (EPIC) SoC, translating the Marketing Requirement Document (MRD) into a complete, internally consistent, and implementable Product Requirement Document (PRD) covering digital, analog, I/O, and memory subsystems.

You will own the digital and high-speed I/O subsystem architecture directly, with particular depth in high-speed SerDes and the protocol digital logic for UCIe, PCIe, and Ethernet. Working closely with the Analog/RF System Architect, Photonics System Architect, Package Electrical/SI Architect, memory subsystem owner, product management, and engineering teams, you will integrate their subsystem architectures into one coherent overall product architecture.

To join our team, you should be excited to

- Own the overall EPIC SoC technical leadership from initial concept through production and drive cross-functional technical alignment across photonics, analog, digital, technology, and product teams.

- Build and document the overall product architecture, translating the MRD into a complete PRD and ensuring architectural decisions, technical requirements, dependencies, and trade-offs are consistently aligned across teams.

- Own the digital subsystem architecture, including core logic, on-chip interconnect fabric, and subsystem partitioning.

- Own the high-speed I/O subsystem architecture, with particular depth in high-speed SerDes and the protocol digital logic for UCIe, PCIe, and Ethernet, including how protocol layers map onto the physical SerDes implementation.

- Partner with the Analog/RF System Architect, Photonics System Architect, Package Electrical/SI Architect, and memory subsystem owner to integrate their architectures and ensure the full-chip architecture is internally consistent and feasible within the target electrical, physical, and packaging constraints.

- Drive full-chip performance, power, and area (PPA) trade-off analysis, partner with external vendors/3rd-party IP providers on full-chip validation and characterization teams on product characterization, and make the calls needed to keep the PRD internally consistent.

- Present the integrated architecture and PRD to product management and engineering leadership and own it through to sign-off.

Your Qualifications

ESSENTIAL

- 7-10 years of experience in SoC or product architecture roles, with proven SoC/product architecture ownership and demonstrated experience taking a product from MRD-level requirements through a complete, implementable PRD-level architecture covering multiple subsystems and at least one full product architecture cycle.

- Deep, hands-on high-speed I/O subsystem expertise, parti

title: Analista Digital de Medios
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships - all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open - we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

Resumen e Impacto del Rol

Este rol forma parte de WPP Media Chile, donde tendrás un papel  apoyando a uno de nuestros clientes estratégicos en la planificación, coordinación y seguimiento de campañas digitales. Serás uno de los puntos de contacto entre el cliente, y equipos especialistas, asegurando una ejecución eficiente y alineada con los objetivos de negocio.  

Buscamos un profesional con capacidad para gestionar campañas digitales de principio a fin, coordinar múltiples stakeholders y generar recomendaciones basadas en resultados. Su contribución será fundamental para asegurar la calidad operativa, fortalecer la relación con el cliente y apoyar el cumplimiento de los objetivos comerciales y de marketing.

Habilidades y Experiencia

• 2 a 5 años de experiencia en agencias de medios, marketing digital o roles similares.

• Tener conocimiento implementando campañas en Meta, Google, Tiktok, otros deseables.

• Manejo de Excel y PowerPoint.

• Capacidad analítica, organización, proactividad y orientación al cliente.

Vida en WPP Media y Beneficios

Nuestra pasión por construir la nueva era de los medios cobra vida gracias a nuestro compromiso con Ser Extraordinarios ( Be Extraordinary ), invirtiendo en nuestra gente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora. También Lideramos con Optimismo ( Lead Optimistically ), creyendo firmemente e Impulsando el Crecimiento y Desarrollo ( Championing Growth and Development ) de cada persona. Este compromiso permite a nuestro equipo en WPP Media aprovechar la amplia red global de WPP Media y WPP para perseguir sus pasiones, construir conexiones profesionales clave y aprender en la vanguardia del marketing y la publicidad.

Creamos un Entorno Abierto ( Create an Open Environment ) basado en la confianza y el respeto, donde cada persona sienta que pertenece y tenga oportunidades reales de crecer. Esta cultura inclusiva se fomenta a través de diversos grupos de recursos para empleados (ERG) y eventos frecuentes en la oficina para destacar los logros del equipo, compartir liderazgo de pensamiento y celebrar fechas especiales e hitos importantes. Nuestro paquete integral de beneficios refleja este compromiso e incluye seguro médico, de visión y dental, planes grupales de retiro, un generoso programa de tiempo libre pagado, descuentos preferenciales con aliados y días dedicados al bienestar y la salud mental de nuestro equipo.

En WPP Media ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades y consideramos todas las postulaciones sin discriminación. Creemos que el mejor trabajo surge cuando estamos juntos, potenciando la creatividad, la colaboración y la conexión en un entorno abierto y colaborativo. Por eso, hemos adoptado un modelo de trabajo híbrido. Si requieres alguna adaptación o flexibilidad, te invitamos a conversarlo con el equipo de selección durante el proceso de entrevista. Ten en cuenta que, si bien nuestra filosofía es la misma en todo WPP, los beneficios específicos pueden variar según la oficina o el país.

Por favor, consulta nuestro Aviso de Privacidad ( https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy ) para obtener más información sobre cómo procesamos la información que nos proporcionas.

Agradecemos a todas las personas que se postulen a esta vacante; sin embargo, solo contactaremos a los candidatos seleccionados para una entrevista.

title: Director of Instructional Design

You will be the instructional design voice of the company: coaching customers as they roll Curie out to their faculty, setting the standards our designers work to, and making sure the ID work we sell is scoped, staffed, and delivered well.

This is a player-coach role. You will lead a distributed team of instructional designers, including contractors, while still rolling up your sleeves on customer training, product testing, and proposal work. You will partner closely with the Director of Project Management and the VP of Product Development.

What you'll do

Customer enablement

• Advise and train customers on implementing Curie with their faculty, including onboarding sessions, workshops, and faculty-facing guidance.

• Speak credibly to instructional design principles and best practices with customers, faculty, and academic leaders.

• Create and maintain training materials, job aids, and implementation guides for Curie.

Team leadership

• Provide day-to-day direction to a distributed team of instructional designers, including employees and contractors, all working remotely.

• Set scope for instructional design development on each project and assign work accordingly.

• Recruit, hire, and onboard qualified instructional designers and contractors as project demand requires.

• Give regular, constructive feedback and review work for quality and consistency.

Standards and quality

• Establish and maintain instructional design standards for work built with Alchemy and Curie.

• Ensure course designs meet accessibility and quality expectations, such as WCAG and Quality Matters.

Product partnership

• Serve as the instructional design subject-matter expert for the Product Development team, weighing in on features and roadmap when asked.

• Bring customer feedback and field insights back to the product team.

Scoping and delivery

• Scope the instructional design portion of RFPs and proposals using the Alchemy product catalog.

• Partner with the Director of Project Management to deliver projects within scope, budget, and timeline.

• Work with the Director of Project Management to design repeatable, scalable approaches for large or multi-course projects.

• Coordinate with outside vendors and partners when projects require it.

• Lead projects as the instructional designer yourself when the situation warrants it.

What you bring

• Master's degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Education, or a related field (bachelor's with equivalent experience considered).

• 5+ years of instructional design experience in higher education, including online and hybrid course development.

• 2+ years leading or directing instructional designers, including remote team members or contractors.

• Strong command of instructional design models and learning science, such as ADDIE, backward design, and UDL.

• Experience training or consulting with faculty and academic stakeholders.

• Experience scoping ID work for proposals, statements of work, or project estimates.

• Working knowledge of multiple LMSs, such as Canvas, Blackboard, D2L Brightspace, or Moodle.

• Clear, confident communication and presentation skills with both technical and academic audiences.

• Comfort testing software and giving structured, actionable feedback to product teams.

• Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1/2.2) and accessibility testing.

• Experience using AI tools as well as design and interactive creation tools such as the articulate suite, h5p, etc.

Nice to have

• Experience in workforce development or corporate learn

You will champion key public sector compliance initiatives, safeguard Snowflake's US public sector certifications, and align IT, Legal, Product, Security, and Engineering around the work that powers Snowflake's growth in government markets.

AS A SENIOR COMPLIANCE ANALYST, SNOWGOV COMPLIANCE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

- Own and maintain core FedRAMP authorization artifacts, including the System Security Plan (SSP), Contingency Plan (ISCP), and Incident Response Plan (IRP), keeping them accurate and updated annually.

- Manage the lifecycle of Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&M), tracking findings, risks, and remediation commitments through closure with clear ownership and realistic deadlines.

- Coordinate annual 3PAO assessments and continuous monitoring, acting as the primary liaison between Snowflake, assessors, and federal agency stakeholders.

- Advise Engineering and Operations teams so cloud configurations (FIPS 140-3 validation, boundary protection, access control, logging and monitoring) meet federal and DoD mandates.

- Perform gap analyses for new or evolving public sector requirements, such as emerging CMMC or GovRAMP mandates and FedRAMP Consolidated Rules, and define technical remediation roadmaps.

- Respond to customer and regulator inquiries about Snowflake's public sector security and compliance obligations, and build self-service resources so customers and field teams can increasingly answer these questions themselves.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR COMPLIANCE ANALYST, SNOWGOV COMPLIANCE WILL HAVE:

- 5+ years of experience in risk management, compliance, GRC, or a related governance function within a regulated or public sector environment preferred.

- Working knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 controls and the FedRAMP authorization process.

- Experience contributing to SSPs, POA&Ms, contingency plans (ISCP), and incident response plans (IRP).

- Experience writing and maintaining audit-ready governance artifacts, including policies, standards, procedures, and control narratives.

- Experience coordinating with 3PAOs, auditors, or assessors during annual assessments or continuous monitoring cycles.

- Ability to influence stakeholders across Engineering, IT, Legal, and Security to drive control implementation and remediation without direct authority.

- Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent audit and assessment timelines and track findings through closure.

- Experience using AI to automate or streamline manual compliance workflows.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

- CISSP, CISM, CISA, or other information security certifications

- Experience with DoD Impact Level authorizations and CMMC certification

Key Responsibilities
Technical Leadership & Architecture

•
System Design: Architect, design, and implement distributed, highly scalable, and fault-tolerant Java applications for complex order routing, execution, and position management.

•
Performance Optimization: Drive continuous latency reduction, memory management tuning, and performance optimization across the entire trading infrastructure.

•
Modernization: Evaluate legacy OMS components and spearhead migration paths to modern event-driven architectures and microservices.

Team Management & Delivery

•
People Leadership: Mentor, coach, and manage a distributed team of senior Java developers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and agile delivery.

•
Execution: Own the end-to-end software development lifecycle (SDLC), ensuring timely delivery of high-quality code that complies with rigorous regulatory and security standards.

Code Quality: Enforce best practices in CI/CD pipelines, automated testing (unit, integration, and performance), and comprehensive code reviews.

Business Alignment & Collaboration

•
Stakeholder Management: Partner with front-office business stakeholders, including Traders, Quants, Risk Management, and Compliance teams, to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

•
Vendor Integration: Oversee integration with internal and external entities, including market data feeds, exchange connectivity (FIX protocol), and third-party OMS/EMS vendors.

Required Qualifications & Skills
Technical Expertise

•
Core Java Mastery: Extensive production experience with Core Java (Java 17/21 preferred), focusing on multi-threading, concurrency, low-garbage-collection idioms, and memory modeling.

•
Trading Expertise: Proven track record working directly on Order Management Systems (OMS) , Execution Management Systems (EMS), or algorithmic trading platforms.

•

•
Data Tier: Experience with high-performance databases (e.g., NoSQL, time-series databases like KDB+/TimescaleDB, or highly optimized relational databases).

Leadership & Domain Knowledge

•
Experience: 10+ years of software engineering experience in capital markets, investment banking, or fintech, with at least 3+ years in a team lead or management capacity.

•
Financial Domain: Strong understanding of financial instruments (Equities, Fixed Income, Derivatives, or FX) and market structures (order books, matching engines, compliance checking).

•
Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.

title: Head of Public Relations
description:
SKEELO: EMBARQUE NA JORNADA QUE COLOCA A LEITURA NO CENTRO DE TUDO. 🐿️

QUEM SOMOS 💚

O Skeelo é uma plataforma digital de leitura que conecta pessoas a e-books, audiobooks e minibooks em uma experiência acessível e personalizada. Desde 2019, usamos a tecnologia como um meio para democratizar o acesso à leitura e ampliar seu impacto no desenvolvimento das pessoas.

Acreditamos que ler vai além do lazer: é uma ferramenta poderosa para expandir repertórios, fortalecer o pensamento crítico e impulsionar o desenvolvimento humano.

NOSSA VIBE 💚

Estamos distribuídos e distribuídas pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, movidos por inovação, agilidade e aprendizado contínuo, que valoriza a diversidade e transforma a leitura para se adaptar à vida das pessoas. Fazemos tudo isso com transparência nas relações, coragem para inovar, foco em alta performance, olhar constante para encantar clientes e leitores e entregas ágeis que fazem a diferença.

Nosso modelo de trabalho é remote first, tirando o melhor do home office: autorresponsabilidade com autonomia. Porém também acreditamos na conexão e trocas dos encontros presenciais, desse modo, temos alguns encontros presenciais em São Paulo - SP, para conexão com os demais Skeelers. Mas relaxa, o Skeelo sempre organiza tudo pra gente.

O time de Relações Institucionais está precisando de alguém, e queremos você com a gente!
Sua missão? Liderar a estratégia global de Relações Públicas da Skeelo , construindo e protegendo a reputação da marca em mercados do Brasil à Europa - sendo o principal guardião da narrativa externa da empresa.

O seu dia a dia no Skeelo vai ser assim:

• Definir e executar a estratégia global de PR, coordenando agências locais no Brasil, LATAM e Europa (Espanha, Itália, Alemanha e Reino Unido)

• Gerenciar crises institucionais e de reputação, desenvolvendo o playbook de crise e treinando lideranças para resposta rápida e adequada

• Construir e consolidar o "colchão reputacional" da Skeelo por meio de relações com a mídia, produção de conteúdo editorial e presença estratégica em eventos

• Coordenar a comunicação da agenda ESG da empresa, traduzindo iniciativas de impacto social em narrativas relevantes para investidores e stakeholders globais

• Apoiar o posicionamento do Board e das lideranças de país em comunicações institucionais, entrevistas e aparições públicas

Para isso, você vai precisar ter:

• Experiência sólida em Relações Públicas, comunicação corporativa ou Corporate Affairs, preferencialmente em empresas de tecnologia ou com operação internacional

• Capacidade de desenvolver narrativas globais adaptadas a contextos culturais e regulatórios distintos

• Experiência em gestão de crises de reputação e relacionamento com veículos de mídia de alto nível

• Domínio do inglês (espanhol será um diferencial importante dado o escopo LATAM e Europa)

E seria muito bom se você também tivesse:

• Vivência ou profundo conhecimento dos mercados europeus, especialmente Reino Unido, Alemanha, Espanha ou Itália

• Experiência com comunicação de agenda ESG e relatórios de sustentabilidade

• Background em empresas do setor de tecnologia, mídia, educação ou mercado editorial

title: Duck Creek QA Analyst
description:
Duck Creek QA Analyst

Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled QA Analyst with specialized expertise in the Duck Creek platform to join our IT Services team. In this critical role, the successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring the integrity, performance, and reliability of our insurance technology solutions throughout the software development lifecycle. This position is pivotal in managing complex testing scenarios related to cloud and data migrations, state-specific regulatory rollouts, and billing systems. The ideal professional will possess deep knowledge of Duck Creek Policy and Billing modules, leveraging their experience to drive high-quality UAT processes and seamless integration testing for enterprise-level applications.

Responsibilities

• Execute comprehensive testing strategies for Duck Creek Policy and Billing modules, ensuring alignment with business requirements and regulatory standards.

• Design and implement test cases for cloud migration initiatives, focusing on data integrity and system performance during transitions.

• Conduct rigorous data migration validation to ensure accuracy and consistency between legacy systems and new cloud environments.

• Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities, collaborating with stakeholders to validate US State Rollouts and ensure compliance with regional mandates.

• Perform end-to-end integration testing to verify seamless connectivity between Duck Creek components and external third-party systems.

• Manage and execute regression testing suites to confirm that new updates or patches do not disrupt existing functionalities.

• Utilize API testing tools and Postman to validate service endpoints and ensure robust data exchange mechanisms.

• Maintain detailed test documentation and track defects using Jira, providing regular status reports to project management teams.

• Support the development and maintenance of automated test scripts to enhance testing efficiency and coverage.

Requirements

Requirements:

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in Quality Assurance within the IT Services sector.

• Proven expertise in testing Duck Creek Policy and Duck Creek Billing platforms.

• Strong proficiency in SQL for data validation and query execution.

• Hands-on experience with API testing and the use of Postman for service verification.

• Demonstrated background in Cloud Migration Testing and Data Migration validation.

• Solid understanding of Regression Testing methodologies and best practices.

• Experience managing UAT cycles and coordinating with business users for sign-off.

• Proficiency in using Jira for defect tracking and project management.

• Familiarity with Integration Testing in complex enterprise environments.

• Specific experience with US State Rollouts and navigating regional compliance requirements.

• Knowledge of Duck Creek QA/Testing frameworks and tools.

Niezależnie od Twojego doświadczenia, pochodzenia, tożsamości płciowej czy indywidualnych okoliczności, to Twoja osobowość nas najbardziej interesuje. title: Senior Director, Product and Technology
description:
Senior Director, Product and Technology

Location: Remote,

Application Submission Deadline: November 1, 2026

About Us

Propel America addresses a broken workforce system that fails both young adults and healthcare employers, sidelining talented individuals from entering healthcare careers and contributing to critical workforce shortages that threaten community health. Propel’s work centers on bridging this gap by creating alternative, debt-free career pathways into healthcare for young adults ages 18-26, particularly those from underrepresented and low-income backgrounds, while helping employers access the trained, diverse talent they urgently need. Today, over 13 million young adults in the U.S. are either not in school, not working, or stuck in low-wage jobs with little room for growth. Traditional college remains financially and logistically out of reach for many, especially young people from low-income communities, forcing them into a false choice: sacrifice income to pursue an expensive degree or remain in low-wage work without upward mobility. At the same time, systemic barriers, such as limited exposure to healthcare roles, low visibility of alternative pathways, and a lack of representative mentors, prevent many high school graduates from entering the healthcare field.

Meanwhile, healthcare employers face compounding workforce shortages. The Bureau of Labor Statistics projects a 13% growth in healthcare jobs from 2021 to 2031, translating to nearly 2 million openings annually. Many of these are middle-skill roles, which represent over half the U.S. labor market but remain unfilled due to a lack of training infrastructure. Employers often contend with high turnover in entry-level positions yet underinvest in structured career advancement pathways or innovative strategies to retain talent.

Propel America aims to solve both sides of the equation, by equipping young adults with the skills and support to launch healthcare careers and by helping employers build stronger, more diverse, and more stable workforces. In our portfolio, we offer a suite of Propel Paths and Propel Products to place young adults in critical talent gaps in healthcare

To learn more about Propel America , please visit .

Propel America is undergoing an exciting phase of growth and technological transformation, marked by the development of our signature Fellow Portal and the integration of cutting-edge AI technologies into our program delivery. To lead this effort, we are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Director, Product and Technology.

This role sits within our newly formed Solutions Team and reports directly to the Vice President of Solutions.

The Director will serve as our core technology lead, managing the technical implementation of our product roadmap, maintaining the integrity of our overall technology stack, and directly supervising our technical staff (Salesforce Administrator and Junior Product Developer).

Key Responsibilities

The ideal candidate is a product developer who can set a vision and design the technology roadmap while also architecting integrations, managing developers and salesforce administration as well as overseeing outsourced Managed Service Providers (MSPs). The Direct will act as the critical link between Propel’s strategic vision and our day-to-day software execution, ensuring that our infrastructure is secure, scalable, and built to support our fellows' journey

description:
Job Title: In-Home Physician Per Diem - Terre Haute
Job Location: Work at Home, Indiana, United States
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Part time
Job Seniority Level:
We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD
Per diem employees qualify for:

• Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

Anticipated Weekly Hours

title: FP&A Data Analyst
description:
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Do you like knowing exactly why a number moved? As an FP&A Data Analyst at ARQ, you'll own the data foundations behind our revenue, cost and management reporting. You'll sit between Finance and Engineering: building the models that tell us how the business is performing, keeping them accurate every day, and turning them into insight that leadership uses to make decisions.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable in a dbt project or a Python codebase as in a P&L. You'll work closely with Finance, Treasury and Engineering, and your work will feed management, investor and regulatory reporting directly.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Own the finance data layer: Maintain and extend our dbt repo. That means building and refactoring models, writing tests, and keeping finance data clean, documented and reliable.

- Revenue and cost models: Build and maintain the models behind revenue, unit economics and operations costs (payment rails, FX, card, banking partners, vendors) across our markets.

- Management accounts: Support daily and monthly management accounts on both accrual and cash basis. Reconcile them to source systems and explain movements.

- Budgeting and forecasting: Feed actuals into the budget and forecast, run variance analysis, and help Finance understand what is driving performance.

- Python services: Help maintain and improve the internal Python services and pipelines that support finance reporting and reconciliation.

- Data mapping and requirements: Map data sources across our product and payments stack, and document business logic and assumptions so others can trust and reuse your work.

- Onboard new business: When we launch a new product, partner or market, make sure it flows correctly into financial reporting, controls and processes.

- Dashboards and reporting: Build and improve dashboards with Finance and Controllership that track key metrics and surface business drivers.

- Anomalies and controls: Spot breaks, unusual spikes or data quality issues early, find the root cause, and fix it at the source.

- Data literacy: Help the wider team understand and self-serve finance data.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- 3+ years in a data, analytics or FP&A role, ideally in fintech, banking or payments

- Strong SQL and solid Python

- Hands-on experience with dbt (or a similar transformation tool) and version control (Git)

- A good grasp of financial statements, management accounts and core finance concepts (accruals, revenue recognition, unit economics)

- A quantitative background, through education or experience

- Strong attention to detail and a quality-first mindset, while still able to work to tight deadlines

- Clear communication: you can explain a variance to a CFO and a data model to an engineer

- Initiative to automate repetitive work and improve how things are done

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with regulatory or external reporting

- Exposure to reconciliations, treasury or general ledger data

- Experience with BI tools (Metabase, Looker, Power BI) and orchestration tools (Airflow or similar)

- Experience maintaining production code: code review, testing, CI/CD

- Spanish or Portuguese proficiency

BENEFITS

- Competitive salary

- Sign-on stock options bonus, so you share in the company's success

- Discretionary performance bonus (stock options)

- Paid annual leave

- Real ownership of work that directly affects how the business is run

- The latest technology to work with

- A strong team that will help you grow your skills

Be part of a team that unleashes the power of leading-edge technologies to help improve the health and well-being of those most vulnerable in our country and communities. Working at Gainwell carries its rewards. You’ll have an incredible opportunity to grow your career in a company that values work flexibility, learning, and career development. You’ll add to your technical credentials and certifications while enjoying a generous, flexible vacation policy and educational assistance. We also have comprehensive leadership and technical development academies to help build your skills and capabilities.

Your role in our mission

Essential Job Functions

• Oversees the development and implementation of corporate-wide application security procedures in client environments to meet corporate and government regulations.

• Ensures that application security procedures meet business requirements and that information is safeguarded against unauthorized use, disclosure or modification, and damage or loss.

• Oversees the implementation of appropriate access controls to ensure that access to systems, data and programs is restricted to authorized and trained users. Oversees the destruction of highly sensitive confidential information in accordance with policies and procedures.

• Develops and implements detailed security procedures. Oversees security administrator team to ensure compliance with client security procedures. Ensures compliance with program security requirements including personnel, physical and administrative security systems and procedures.

• Serves as a subject matter expert concerning security procedures and audit compliance.

• Coordinates sensitive aspects of corporate security programs to ensure compliance with client, government and company security policies and procedures including verifying adherence to specific policies and ensuring policy compliance with government regulations.

• Provides leadership and work guidance to less experienced personnel.

• Develops, coordinates and conducts security education programs to educate appropriate personnel about security systems and their importance.

• Investigates or oversees the investigation of losses and security violations and recommends corrective actions. Implements approved course of action as appropriate. Provides summaries for senior management review.

• Researches technological advancements to ensure that security solutions are continuously improved, supported and aligned with industry and company standards.

What we're looking for

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology or related field preferred

• Nine or more years of experience in information systems security or computer operations

• Experience working with corporate level security systems and implementation procedures

• Experience working with corporate and government security regulations

• Experience working with company security software products

• Experience working with domain structures, user authentication, user profiles and digital signatures

• Possess a security clearance at the Secret level and/or certified information security systems professional (CISSP) certification

Other Qualifications

• Strong personal computer and business solutions software skills

• Strong communication skills to interact with team members, customers, management and support personnel

• Strong analytical and problem solving skills for design, creation and testing of security systems

• Leadership skills to guide and mentor the work of less experienced personnel

• Strong research skills

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team

• Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and switch between tasks quickly

What you should expect in this role

• Remote-based opportunity within the United States

title: Director, Sanctions
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

Airwallex is scaling a global sanctions programme across multiple jurisdictions, payment rails, and regulatory expectations. You'll provide the second-line leadership, challenge, and transformation needed to keep the programme effective, defensible, and ready for what comes next.

- Own and continuously elevate Airwallex’s global sanctions strategy, policy framework, and second-line governance across all operating jurisdictions, including OFAC, the EU, UK OFSI, the UN, MAS, HKMA, AUSTRAC, and local regimes.

- Provide independent second-line oversight and challenge of first-line customer, payment, and counterparty screening operations, setting global standards for investigative quality, threshold tuning, and risk-based decision-making.

- Act as the global second-line escalation point for complex sanctions nexus determinations, potential hits, voluntary self-disclosures, asset freezing, and high-risk commercial deal approvals.

- Partner with Data, Product, and Engineering to co-design and validate fuzzy logic, name and transaction screening algorithms, geographic blocking mechanisms, and AI/ML-driven alert reduction systems, ensuring model defensibility and explainability.

- Lead the roadmap to modernise sanctions screening through AI-assisted workflows, graph analysis, automated detection, and real-time capabilities for cross-border payment rails.

- Lead regulatory examinations, supervisory inquiries, and complex due diligence reviews from global banking partners, keeping systems and decision trails audit-ready by design.

- Monitor geopolitical developments, sanctions evasion typologies, trade controls, and enforcement trends, translating changes into platform requirements ahead of regulatory deadlines.

- Report sanctions programme health, residual risk, key performance indicators, and emerging risk trends to executive leadership, risk committees, and the board.

- Lead, inspire, and scale a high-performing team of sanctions managers and subject matter experts across multiple regions.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

ESSENTIALS

- 12+ years of dedicated experience in sanctions compliance and financial crime risk management.

- Executive leadership experience managing cross-regional teams in a second-line-of-defence or global policy capacity.

- Deep expertise in global cross-border payments, multi-currency account structures, foreign exchange, platform or embedded finance, or digital asset ecosystems.

- Expert knowledge of global sanctions regimes, including OFAC, the EU, UK OFSI, the UN, MAS, HKMA, and AUSTRAC, as well as trade restrictions, export controls, and sanctions evasion techniques.

- Experience providing independent oversight of customer, payment, and counterparty screening operations.

- A track record of evaluating, tuning, or deploying modern sanctions technology, including AI/NLP-assisted screening tools, graph databases,

title: Groves Junior Office Manager
description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Junior Office Manager to join our Groves-based team.

Position Description

The Junior Office Manager supports day-to-day operations at the Groves workplace, enabling the visitor experience, as well as helping keep the office organized, functional, secure, and welcoming. Working closely with Facility Launch & Operations Support, this role assists with visitor experiences and logistics, supplies, onboarding, vendor visits, and other routine workplace needs so employees can focus on their work.

The Junior Office Manager also provides onsite support for office and facility requests. This role helps document requests, coordinate schedules and access, share updates, and follow up on assigned tasks. Facility Launch & Operations Support and the appropriate functional owners guide facility projects, specialized work, approvals, and decisions outside the scope of this junior role.

The Junior Office Manager will partner closely with Oklo’s Business Operations, People, Media and Comms, IT, Finance, Security, and Environmental Health and Safety teams to support consistent company-wide processes at the Groves location.

Specific responsibilities may include:

Front Office & Communications

• Welcome visitors and coordinate site access in accordance with Oklo’s security requirements.

• Manage incoming and outgoing mail, shipping, office communications, and shared workplace information.

• Respond to routine office requests and direct questions that need specialized support to the appropriate team.

People & Culture Support

• Coordinate the workplace portions of employee onboarding and offboarding, including workspaces, equipment, badges, and office orientation.

• Lead in efforts to support and improve the facility experience for visitors.

• Contribute to the facility’s educational elements through the lens of graphic design and human factors.

• Assists with onsite logistics for meetings, employee events, workplace activities, and site tours, including scheduling, visitor communications, space setup, refreshments, access coordination, and day-of support.

• Help create a welcoming, inclusive, and productive workplace experience.

Facilities & Vendor Coordination

• Help keep office and common areas organized, functional, and ready for use by checking spaces regularly and reporting issues.

• Support Facility Launch & Operations Support with vendor visits by gathering quotes, organizing invoices for review, and following up on routine service requests.

• Log maintenance needs involving HVAC, electrical, plumbing, janitorial service, furniture, equipment, access controls, and other building services, then route them to the appropriate team or provider.

• Help collect scopes of work and required approvals, arrange site access once work is approved, and keep records of maintenance, inspections, and repairs up to date.

• Assist with routine onsite tasks, such as basic furniture moves and equipment checks. Help with cable connections or device restarts only when authorized and directed by the responsible team.

• Support larger office improvements and equipment installations by preparing spaces, helping vendors access the site, and sharing schedule updates with affected employees.

Cross-Functional Facilitation

• Support Facility Launch & Operations Support by helping connect onsite and remote employees, service providers, and the appropriate Oklo teams during facility-related work.

• Provide basic onsite assistance under the direction of the responsible team when work requires specialized expertise or approval.

• Help maintain records of ongoing work, including the request, owner, required approvals, schedule, and current status.

• Share approved schedules, outages, access restrictions, safety requirements, and project updates with affected employees.

• Follow up on assigned requests and promptly flag delays, unclear ownership, unexpected condition

title: Lead Software Engineer – Payments
description:
ORDERYOYO
Lead Software Engineer - Payments
Remote · Quarterly team gatherings in one of our global offices · Competitive salary
About the Role
At OrderYOYO , payments sit at the heart of everything we do. Every order placed, every restaurant paid, and every dispute resolved runs through the systems this team owns and operates.
We're looking for a Lead Software Engineer - Payments to own the next stage of our payments platform's evolution - as a hands-on technical leader who can grow and manage a team of payments engineers, set the technical direction for a business-critical domain, and support our transition to a more scalable operating model across online ordering and in-store platforms (POS, Kiosk, and payment terminals).
You'll play a central role in shaping how OrderYOYO handles money - from authorisation and settlement to disputes and merchant invoicing - while building and developing the people who make that possible.
Role Mission
Lead the people, architecture, and delivery behind OrderYOYO 's payments platform - enabling KYC onboarding, deductions, settlement/payout timing, dispute flows, and merchant invoicing - while growing a high-performing engineering team and raising the bar on reliability, security, and engineering quality in one of our most business-critical domains.
Core Responsibilities
People Leadership & Team Development

• Lead, mentor, and grow a team of payments engineers - providing hands-on technical guidance, regular feedback, and clear paths for career development.

• Own hiring and team-building for the payments engineering function, partnering with recruiting to define role profiles, run interviews, and bring in strong talent.

• Run day-to-day people management: 1:1s, goal-setting, performance reviews, and career progression conversations for direct reports.

• Build a team culture where payments knowledge is documented and shared, not tribal - through design reviews, standards, and mentoring.

• Represent the payments engineering team in leadership and cross-functional conversations, translating business needs into technical strategy and team priorities.

• Balance hands-on technical contribution with people-management responsibilities, staying close enough to the codebase to lead by example and unblock the team.

Technical & Domain Ownership

• Set the technical direction and long-term architecture strategy for payment-domain services, including gateway integrations, payment intent/authorisation/capture/refund flows, payout orchestration, and reconciliation.

• Oversee marketplace capabilities: onboarding/KYC integration, merchant configuration, settlement instructions, deductions, and invoicing/merchant-statement alignment.

• Ensure robust “flow-of-funds” primitives across the team's systems - idempotency, ledgers/events, and audit trails that are fully supportable for finance and compliance.

• Own the strategy for PSP and partner integrations, with close attention to tri-party / sub-merchant implications where applicable.

• Oversee dispute/chargeback and fraud-handling touchpoints across internal workflows and PSP tooling, and drive collaboration with Ops on runbooks and escalation paths.

• Partner closely with Product, Legal/Compliance, Finance, and Support to convert requirements into safe, testable production behaviour.

• Raise engineering quality in a high-change domain: automated testing, safe rollouts/canaries, observability, and incident-response improvements, with accountability for outcomes across the team.

Must-Have Requirements

• Proven experience leading, mentoring, or people-managing a team of software engineers - including hiring, performance management, and career development.

• Strong backend engineering background in distributed systems - microservices, async processing, resilient APIs, and eventual consistency.

• Production experience with payment flows (auth/capture/refund, webhooks, reconciliation) and “money correctness” patterns such as idempotency keys, double-e

title: Senior Technical Recruiter, AI Research
locationText: Cambridge, MA USA; San Francisco, CA USA
description:
Your Impact at LILA

As an AI Research Recruiter at Lila Sciences, you will partner directly with our AI research and engineering teams to identify, engage, and hire the researchers and engineers building our AI-driven platform. This is a strategic, full-cycle role: you'll shape hiring plans with research leadership, build Lila's reputation in the AI research community, and go deep in high-signal technical channels to reach talent that isn't sitting on a job board.

What You'll Be Building

• Develop and execute strategic recruiting plans for AI/ML research and engineering roles, from hiring-manager intake through screen, interview loop management, offer strategy, and close.

• Partner with AI Research hiring managers and interview panels to translate team needs into sourcing strategy, candidate personas, and role calibration.

• Build and sustain a high-trust network of ML researchers and applied scientists across subfields (LLM, RL, Generative AI) through consistent relationship-building, community presence, and non-traditional discovery loops (research publications, GitHub, conferences, open-source).

• Partner with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to map long-term AI/ML talent strategy and balance hiring priorities across research teams.

• Build and iterate on recruiting processes that maintain a high, consistent talent bar while actively removing bias from the hiring process.

• Strengthen Lila's employer brand within the ML research and scientific community - representing our mission, culture, and technical work to candidates with strong options elsewhere.

• Stay current on sourcing techniques, interview innovation, and AI/ML talent-market trends; bring new approaches back to the team.

• Maintain operational rigor: pipeline hygiene, recruiting metrics (time-to-fill, slate quality, source efficacy), and clear communication with candidates and hiring teams.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience supporting technical research teams, with a track record of recruiting AI/ML research talent specifically.

• Strong existing network in the ML research community (NeurIPS, ICML, top CS/ML programs).

• Proven ability to attract passive candidates from leading academic institutions and frontier labs, and to scale a high-performing technical hiring function.

• Strong technical aptitude - comfortable understanding and evaluating ML/research qualifications alongside hiring managers.

• Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills with senior technical leaders.

• Comfortable operating with autonomy and juggling shifting priorities in a fast-moving environment.

Bonus Points For

• Deep interest in AI's potential and a realistic view of its risks and limitations - genuine enthusiasm for Lila's scientific mission.

• Hands-on experience with agentic recruiting tools/workflows (automations, enrichment/triage helpers) to improve candidate discovery.

• Experience recruiting at a deep-tech or frontier AI research organization.

• International recruiting experience across multiple regions.

Compensation

title: Director, Advancement
description:
Title: Director, Advancement

Department: Advancement

Status: Exempt

Reports To: Vice President of Advancement

Remote position, Preference given to New York City and/or Metro

Summary

The Director, Advancement is a key member of the National Psoriasis Foundation ’s Advancement team, responsible for building and growing relationships with individual donors and prospects to expand philanthropic support for NPF’s mission. This position manages a portfolio across annual, major, and planned giving, with a strong emphasis on developing meaningful donor relationships, securing significant philanthropic commitments, and building a robust pipeline for future growth.

The Director combines frontline fundraising with strategic planning and collaboration, working closely with Advancement leadership, executive leadership, board members, health care professionals, volunteers, and colleagues across NPF to connect donors with the programs, research, and priorities that are most meaningful to them.

As NPF prepares for a future capital campaign and seeks to significantly expand philanthropic investment in its mission, the Director will play an important role in strengthening donor relationships, developing the philanthropic pipeline, and advancing the fundraising practices and infrastructure needed to achieve ambitious organizational goals.

Portfolio Management & Relationship Building

• Manage and grow a portfolio of individual donors and prospects across annual, major, and planned giving.

• Identify and qualify prospective donors with the capacity, inclination, and connection to make meaningful philanthropic investments in NPF.

• Build strong, personalized relationships by understanding each donor’s connection to NPF, philanthropic interests, and motivations for giving.

• Conduct meaningful donor visits, virtual meetings, and personalized outreach to deepen engagement and advance relationships.

• Develop and execute strategic moves management plans that guide donors and prospects through cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.

• Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified prospects to achieve current revenue goals and support long-term individual giving growth.

Major & Planned Giving

• Cultivate, solicit, and secure significant philanthropic commitments from individuals and families, including five-, six-, and seven-figure gifts, as appropriate.

• Partner with the Vice President of Advancement, Chief Development Officer, CEO, board members, health care professionals, and volunteers to develop and execute strategies for key donors and prospects.

• Identify and promote planned and legacy giving opportunities, including bequests, beneficiary designations, charitable gift annuities, and other appropriate giving vehicles.

• Leverage NPF events, programs, and mission experiences as strategic opportunities to cultivate relationships, advance solicitations, and deepen donor engagement.

• Develop compelling giving opportunities that connect donor interests with NPF’s mission, programs, research, and strategic priorities.

• Support NPF special events through strategic donor and honoree engagement, particularly when honorees, event leaders, or key participants are part of the Director’s portfolio or donor relationships.

Donor Engagement & Stewardship

• Develop personalized stewardship strategies that demonstrate impact, strengthen donor relationships, and inspire continued and increased philanthropic support.

• Collaborate with Research, Advocacy, Patient Support, Marketing, and other teams to create meaningful opportunities for donors to experience and understand the impact of NPF’s work.

• Connect donors with NPF leadership, researchers, health care professionals, programs, and volunteer leaders based on their interests and engagement goals.

• Ensure timely and appropriate donor recognition, impact reporting, and stewardship for portfolio donors and prospects.

• Serve as a collaborative partner across the Advancement
